assumptions: The hash-pinned Q0 sensitivity is the fixed-lambda projective kappa derivative of the same selected actual family on the same exact K times Lambda rectangle. Discarding its correlation with rho into a Cartesian interval hull is conservative.

Regular finite-IVP parameter dependence gives Z and D on every finite subinterval. The displayed uniform rotating bounds dominate U and c by constants and Z and D by a constant plus a linear function of Q0-Q.

Because a(Q) decays as exp(3Q/2), a(Q)*(1+Q0-Q) is integrable on the complete minus half-line. This uniform dominator makes H converge and permits the fixed-lambda kappa derivative to pass through the improper Wronskian limit.
The exact corridor has kappa_left>0, so every rotating state scaled by 1/kappa is uniform. At the two corridor faces only the corresponding one-sided derivative is claimed.
The signed tail integral is not assigned a sign. Only its magnitude is bounded, and the lambda factor is enclosed symmetrically.
The singular Weyl-Titchmarsh source fixes boundary/Wronskian scope only. This real projective boundary derivative is not called a Weyl m-function, spectral measure or RAQ object.
